summary: Innventure, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on October 13, 2026, disclosing that subsidiary Accelsius Holdings LLC issued a press release about an operational expansion. Accelsius upgraded its Springdale lab in Austin, Texas to multi-megawatt power for two-phase direct-to-chip liquid cooling tests, expects to add 18,000 square feet of lease space in January 2027, and is expanding its NeuCool product family with a 375kW-capable unit. No financial terms, transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory mechanics were stated. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation; watch for commercialization progress rather than deal terms.
